rationale: The agent verified identity correctly (name + zip matched a single user) and accessed the correct order. However, there were multiple policy and outcome failures: (1) The agent stated the order was “pending” without visible tool support for status. (2) It asserted a business rule that single-item cancellation isn’t possible on a pending order without checking product/order rules via tools. (3) Critically, the user’s cancellation was conditional on refunding to a gift card; if not possible, no cancellation. The agent proceeded to cancel anyway and said the refund would go to the original credit card, violating the user’s explicit condition. (4) The agent later contradicted itself by claiming the order “remains active and has not been cancelled” despite having processed a cancellation, with no tool action to reinstate. (5) It also provided a specific refund amount without clear tool confirmation. These issues constitute performing the wrong action relative to the user’s constraints and providing incorrect final information, so the interaction fails the pass bar.
